about: 간이지급명세서(E030116) — 사업 · 기타소득 서식은 만들 때의 기타원천세를 담아 둔다. 원본 2026-10-14 QA세무-강사: 사업 1,000,000(940909) · 기타 500,000(76) 으로 만들고 사업 200,000 · 기타 300,000(62) 을 더 넣어도 서식은 1,000,000 · 500,000, [새로불러오기] '직접 수정한 사항은 유지되지 않으며 …' 확인 뒤 사업 1,200,000 · 36,000 · 3,600 · 39,600 (한 줄), 기타는 76 · 79 만이라 500,000 그대로. 시험 자료(2091/10, QA세무)는 끝에 지운다.

shots.name: 만들 때 담기 · 새로불러오기
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; const d = await (await fetch('/api/simple-payment-statements', { headers: H })).json(); const ids = d.filter((s) => s.managerDept === 'QA세무' && s.payYear === 2091).map((s) => s.id); if (ids.length) await fetch('/api/simple-payment-statements/delete', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify(ids) }); const m = await (await fetch('/api/other-withholdings?month=2091-10', { headers: H })).json(); for (const w of m.rows.filter((w) => w.payeeName === 'QA세무-강사')) await fetch('/api/other-withholdings/' + w.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); const w = (b) => fetch('/api/other-withholdings', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ payDate: '2091-10-14', payeeName: 'QA세무-강사', description: 'QA세무', ...b }) }); await w({ incomeType: 'BUSINESS', incomeCode: '940909', grossAmount: 1000000 }); await w({ incomeType: 'OTHER', incomeCode: '76', grossAmount: 500000 }); const st = (kind) => fetch('/api/simple-payment-statements', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ kind, payYear: 2091, period: 10, reportDate: '2091-10-31', managerDept: 'QA세무', managerName: 'QA세무', managerPhone: '02-000-0000', submitter: 'DIRECT' }) }); await st('BUSINESS'); await st('OTHER'); await w({ incomeType: 'BUSINESS', incomeCode: '940909', grossAmount: 200000 }); await w({ incomeType: 'OTHER', incomeCode: '62', grossAmount: 300000 }); return 'setup' })()

js:(() => { const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr')].find((t) => t.innerText.includes('2091년 10 - 10월') && t.innerText.includes('사업소득')); [...tr.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === '조회').click(); return 'opened' })()

js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; const d = await (await fetch('/api/simple-payment-statements', { headers: H })).json(); const ids = d.filter((s) => s.managerDept === 'QA세무' && s.payYear === 2091).map((s) => s.id); await fetch('/api/simple-payment-statements/delete', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify(ids) }); const m = await (await fetch('/api/other-withholdings?month=2091-10', { headers: H })).json(); for (const w of m.rows.filter((w) => w.payeeName === 'QA세무-강사')) await fetch('/api/other-withholdings/' + w.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); return 'cleanup' })()
